segments.name: core Lattice business
segments.description: Develops and sells low power programmable FPGAs, silicon-enabling products, and related IP licensing and services for Communications, Computing, Industrial, Automotive, and Consumer markets.
segments.evidence: As of January 3, 2026, we have determined that the Company operates in a single operating and reportable segment: the core Lattice business, which includes silicon-based and silicon-enabling products, evaluation boards, development hardware, and related intellectual property licensing, services, and sales.

revenueModel.text: Customers globally pay Lattice for programmable logic semiconductor products, silicon-enabling products, system solutions, design services, and technology licenses.
revenueModel.evidence: Lattice Semiconductor Corporation and its subsidiaries ("Lattice," the "Company," "we," "us," or "our") develop technologies that we monetize through differentiated programmable logic semiconductor products, silicon-enabling products, system solutions, design services, and technology licenses.
